skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK damage to a single target and restores HP equal to 10% of max HP, up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 30% ATK damage to each enemy in the entire column in a 5-hit combo, with a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] on each target hit for 2 turns (takes additional Injured damage equal to 50% ATK when attacked), and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 10% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 38% ATK damage to each enemy in the entire column in a 5-hit combo, with a 60% chance to inflict [Injured] on each target hit for 2 turns (takes additional Injured damage equal to 50% ATK when attacked), and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs damage equal to 20% of own HP).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. The lower its HP, the higher its [DMG Free] (reduces up to 50% of Direct and Bonus DMG). After being attacked, if own HP is below 80%, counterattacks the enemy with a [Follow-up] (80% Basic ATK DMG and effects).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
